verdict.rationale: The only documented user-configurable event-to-action rule is in Payment Recovery: merchants can choose notifications, turn on Tactical Retries, and choose what happens to past-due subscriptions when a failed payment isn't recovered. Webhooks only push event notifications to your own server, so any action logic must be built by the user. They are a developer building block, not a rules engine, and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a general rule/workflow builder spanning arbitrary events, user-defined conditions and actions beyond dunning, API/MCP management of automation rules, independent corroboration.
